about.heroSubtitle: A vehicle marketplace and sales service designed to make selling your vehicle easier, more convenient, and completely stress-free.
about.whatWeDoPara1: Elite Motors KW is a vehicle listing and sales service based in Kuwait. We help vehicle owners sell their cars and bikes by handling the entire listing process, managing buyer inquiries, and coordinating viewings — so you don't have to.
about.whatWeDoPara2: Whether you're selling a sedan, SUV, sports car, pickup, or motorcycle, we create a professional listing on your behalf, market it to thousands of potential buyers, and manage all communication until your vehicle is sold.
about.processStep1Desc: Reach out via WhatsApp or Instagram with your vehicle details and photographs.
about.processStep2Desc: Our team reviews your information and creates a professional listing on our platform.
about.processStep3Desc: Your listing is published and visible to thousands of potential buyers across Kuwait.
about.processStep4Desc: Interested buyers contact us — not you. We answer their questions and filter out time-wasters.
about.processStep5Desc: When a genuine buyer wants more details or a viewing, we contact you to coordinate the next step.
about.processStep6Desc: Once your vehicle is sold through us, a small pre-agreed commission applies. No hidden fees — terms are discussed before listing.
about.provideSubtitle: To create an accurate and attractive listing, we'll need the following details and photographs from you.
about.accuracyText: Providing accurate and honest information about your vehicle is the responsibility of the owner. Elite Motors KW lists your vehicle based on the details you provide.
about.stressFreeBenefit1Desc: Once your vehicle is listed, potential buyers contact Elite Motors KW instead of you. No more constant calls, messages, or low-ball offers cluttering your phone.
about.stressFreeBenefit2Desc: We answer initial questions from interested buyers and handle all inquiries on your behalf. We filter out time-wasters so you only deal with serious buyers.
about.stressFreeBenefit3Desc: When a genuinely interested buyer wants additional information or to view the vehicle in person, we contact you and coordinate the next step at a time that works for you.
about.tagline: You focus on your life. We handle the buyers.
about.disclaimerText: There is no guarantee that a listed vehicle will sell. The vehicle owner remains fully responsible for the vehicle, its documentation, condition, legal ownership, and any obligations related to the sale.
about.ctaSubtitle: Contact us today to get started. We'll guide you through the process and have your listing live within 24 hours.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.serviceDesc: Elite Motors KW is a vehicle listing and sales service based in Kuwait. We list vehicles on behalf of their owners, manage buyer inquiries, and coordinate viewings. Elite Motors KW does not own, inspect, or guarantee any vehicle listed on the platform. We act solely as an intermediary between vehicle owners and potential buyers.
terms.listingDesc: Vehicle owners are solely responsible for the accuracy, completeness, and honesty of all information provided for their listing, including vehicle condition, mileage, specifications, photographs, and documentation. Elite Motors KW publishes listings based on the details provided by the owner and is not liable for any inaccuracies or misrepresentations.
terms.commissionDesc: Listing a vehicle on Elite Motors KW is free. A commission applies only upon successful sale of the vehicle through our platform. The exact commission rate and terms are discussed and agreed upon between Elite Motors KW and the vehicle owner before the listing goes live. There are no hidden fees. All financial terms are transparent and confirmed in advance.
terms.noGuaranteeDesc: Elite Motors KW does not guarantee that any listed vehicle will be sold. The listing of a vehicle on our platform does not constitute a promise or commitment of sale. Market conditions, pricing, vehicle condition, and buyer interest are factors beyond our control.
terms.userDesc: Users of this website agree to use the platform for lawful purposes only. Vehicle owners must ensure they have legal ownership and the right to sell any vehicle they list. Buyers are responsible for conducting their own due diligence, including inspecting the vehicle, verifying documentation, and ensuring the vehicle meets their requirements before completing any transaction.
terms.liabilityDesc: Elite Motors KW shall not be held liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our platform or services. We are not responsible for the condition, legality, or safety of any vehicle listed. All transactions are conducted between the vehicle owner and the buyer. Elite Motors KW is not a party to the sale agreement.
terms.governingDesc: These terms and conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Kuwait. Any disputes arising from the use of this platform or our services shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Kuwait.
terms.changesDesc: Elite Motors KW reserves the right to update or modify these terms and conditions at any time without prior notice. Continued use of the platform after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
terms.contactDesc: If you have any questions about these terms and conditions, please contact us via WhatsApp at +965 5033 5205 or email at elitemotorskw01@gmail.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.collectDesc: When you use Elite Motors KW to list or inquire about a vehicle, we may collect the following information: vehicle details (brand, model, year, mileage, condition, specifications), photographs of the vehicle, contact information (name, phone number, email address), and any additional details you provide to us through WhatsApp, Instagram, or email.
privacy.useDesc: We use the information we collect to create and publish vehicle listings on our platform, communicate with vehicle owners and potential buyers, coordinate viewings and facilitate the sales process, improve our services and user experience, and respond to inquiries and provide customer support.
privacy.sharingDesc: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. Vehicle listing details (including photos and specifications) are published on our platform and are publicly visible to potential buyers. Your personal contact information is not shared publicly. Buyer inquiries are managed by Elite Motors KW, and we only share your contact details with verified, serious buyers with your consent.
privacy.cookiesDesc: Our website may use basic cookies and similar technologies for analytics purposes to understand how visitors use our site and to improve the user experience. These cookies do not collect personal information and are used solely for aggregated, anonymous usage statistics.
privacy.securityDesc: We take reasonable measures to protect the information you provide to us. However, no method of electronic transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security of your data.
privacy.changesDesc: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page. Continued use of our platform after updates are posted constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.
privacy.contactDesc: If you have any questions or concerns about your privacy or this policy, please contact us via WhatsApp at +965 5033 5205 or email at elitemotorskw01@gmail.com.
